name: Blue Book Traineeship (European Commission)
amount: Monthly grant = 25% of an AD5/1 official's basic salary (amount published each session) + travel allowance
nextText: Next window ~Jul–Sep 2027 for the March 2028 session
fields: EU policy, law, economics, translation, communication, IT and more
note: Five-month paid traineeships (March and October starts) in the Commission and other EU bodies. Applications for the October 2027 session run 15 Feb–12 Mar 2027; the March 2027 window closed on 4 Sep 2026.

name: Schuman Traineeship (European Parliament)
amount: €1,889/month in Brussels & Luxembourg (2025 rate)
dlText: 31 May 2027, 23:59 Brussels time (October 2027 session; estimated from 2026 cycle)

eligibility.note: Mainly nationals of EU Member States and candidate countries; check the internal rules for limited places for other nationals.

fields: Politics, law, communication, economics, translation and general fields
note: Paid five-month traineeships in Parliament's Secretariat (Brussels, Luxembourg, Strasbourg and liaison offices). Two windows a year: 1–31 May (October start) and 1–31 October (March start); the March 2027 window closed 31 Oct 2026.

name: Traineeships at the General Secretariat of the Council
amount: €1,538.16 net/month + €70/month meal allowance + travel allowance
dlText: Opens 8 Feb 2027; closes ~mid-March 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle, time not stated)
tags: Full university degree by closing date

eligibility.note: Primarily nationals of EU Member States; check the official FAQ for rules on other nationalities.

fields: EU affairs, law, economics, IT, communication and more
note: Two five-month paid periods a year in Brussels. The window opening 8 Feb 2027 is for the 1 Sep 2027–31 Jan 2028 traineeship.

name: ECB Traineeship Programme
amount: €1,170/month (€2,120 for advanced PhD trainees) + free ECB residence or €750/month accommodation allowance
dlText: Per vacancy — positions advertised throughout the year
fields: Economics, finance, statistics, law, IT, HR and more
note: Paid traineeships of 3–12 months in Frankfurt. Nationals of acceding countries are also eligible; trainees recruited more than 50 km away get housing paid.

name: EIB Traineeship Programme
amount: €1,500/month (adjusted for offices outside Luxembourg)
fields: Finance, economics, engineering, law, IT, communication
note: Paid traineeships at the EU's bank, mostly in Luxembourg. Open to EU nationals and nationals of EU candidate countries.

name: EIB Traineeship Programme for MENA and ACP Countries
amount: €1,500/month
dlText: Per campaign — check the EIB careers page

eligibility.note: Nationals of Middle East & North Africa or African, Caribbean and Pacific partner countries; the advert lists eligible countries.

fields: Finance, economics, development, engineering
note: Regional traineeship stream at the EIB for nationals of MENA and ACP partner countries, with the same monthly allowance as the main programme.

name: UNDP Internship Programme
amount: Monthly stipend, flat rate by duty station (unless sponsored)
tags: Grad student, final-year bachelor's or recent grad
fields: Development, policy, climate, digital, communications and more
note: UNDP pays non-sponsored interns a monthly stipend that depends on the duty station; part-time/remote internships are prorated. A few postings may differ, so read each vacancy.

name: UNICEF Internship Programme
amount: Monthly stipend by duty station + possible travel/visa lump sum
fields: Child rights, health, education, communications, data and more
note: UNICEF pays interns a monthly stipend towards living costs (rate varies by country) unless sponsored by their university; a one-off travel/visa contribution may be added when funds allow.

name: WHO Internship Programme
amount: Need-based living allowance up to a cap per duty station + insurance (Geneva: lunch vouchers)
fields: Public health, medicine, data, policy, communications
note: Since January 2020 WHO pays a living allowance to interns who declare they lack other funding; the maximum is listed in each vacancy. Some older regional pages still say internships are unpaid.

name: UNHCR Internship Programme
amount: Monthly food & transport allowance = 70% of GS-3 step 1 net salary (50% at 'H' duty stations)
fields: Protection, law, humanitarian affairs, communications, operations
note: UNHCR pays non-sponsored interns a monthly allowance tied to the local General Service salary scale; part-time interns get half.

name: WFP Internship Programme
amount: Stipend up to US$1,000/month (by duty station)
fields: Humanitarian operations, nutrition, logistics, data, communications
note: WFP pays a monthly stipend towards living costs, capped at US$1,000; travel and accommodation are not covered.

name: FAO Internship Programme
host: Food and Agriculture Organization of the UN
amount: Stipend up to US$700/month (by duty station)
fields: Agriculture, food systems, environment, economics, statistics
note: Individual (non-sponsored) interns receive up to US$700/month. Candidates must be nationals of FAO Members (almost every country) and start before turning 31.

name: ILO Internship Programme
amount: Monthly stipend based on local cost of living (unless externally funded)
tags: Final-year master's or graduated within 12 months
fields: Labour, social policy, economics, law, statistics
note: ILO interns receive a cost-of-living-based monthly stipend (e.g. US$550 in Bangkok in 2023 postings); travel and insurance are the intern's responsibility.

name: WBG Pioneers (World Bank Group Internship)
country: United States (Washington DC and country offices)
amount: Paid hourly (fee-based tracks); rate per posting
dlText: Cycle-based; Fall/Winter 2026 closed 12 Aug 2026 — watch for the next cycle

eligibility.note: Citizens of World Bank Group member countries (nearly all countries).

fields: Economics, finance, development, data, engineering and more
note: The World Bank Group's internship scheme replaced the Bank Internship Program; fee-based tracks are paid hourly, while the no-fee track requires university credit or a stipend letter.

name: IMF Fund Internship Program (FIP)
amount: Paid internship — salary per job ad (check official page)
dlText: Per job ad on IMF Workday
fields: Macroeconomics, finance, public finance, specialized fields
note: Paid 10–13 week summer internship at IMF headquarters in Washington DC for PhD students in economics and master's students in specialized fields.

name: OECD Internship Programme
amount: €1,000 per full month (living-expenses contribution, Paris)
tags: Enrolled full-time for the whole internship

eligibility.note: Primarily nationals of OECD member countries; non-member nationals accepted for specific programmes and projects.

fields: Economics, statistics, policy, environment, education, data
note: Interns in Paris get a €1,000/month contribution to living expenses. You must remain enrolled in a degree programme for the full internship.

name: WTO Internship Programme
amount: CHF 60/day (incl. weekends) — ~CHF 1,800/month

eligibility.note: Nationals of WTO Members and of countries/customs territories in accession negotiations.

fields: Trade, economics, law, international relations
note: Paid internships in Geneva with a daily allowance of CHF 60; travel to Geneva is not covered.

name: IAEA Internship Programme
amount: €1,450/month (full-time)

eligibility.note: Generally nationals of IAEA Member States — confirm in the vacancy notice.

fields: Nuclear science, engineering, IT, law, administration
note: Full-time interns in Vienna receive a €1,450 monthly stipend. Applications more than a year after finishing your degree are not considered.

name: ADB Internship Program
amount: Stipend for the internship (amount: check official page)
dlText: ~16 Mar 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle (time not stated)

eligibility.note: Nationals of ADB member countries enrolled in a Master's or PhD at a school in a member country

fields: Economics, finance, development, engineering, IT and other ADB work areas
note: Graduate students intern at ADB (mainly Manila) for 8–12 weeks; all interns receive a stipend except those under special school arrangements. 2026 deadline was 16 Mar for June starts.

name: AfDB Internship Program
amount: Monthly stipend + medical insurance (amount: check official page)
nextText: 2027 Session 1 closed; check for the next session
tags: Master's student or within 1 year of Master's

eligibility.note: Citizens of AfDB member countries (regional African and non-regional members)

fields: Development economics, finance, infrastructure, agriculture, law and other Bank areas
note: 3–6 month internships with a monthly stipend; on-site interns pay their own travel and living costs. Can only be done once.

name: IFAD Internship Programme
amount: 10% of DSA/month (cap US$800); 14% for non-local interns from recipient countries; Enhanced Programme adds housing + travel
fields: Agriculture, rural development, finance, communications and other IFAD areas
note: Six-month paid internships mostly in Rome. The Enhanced Internship Programme for candidates not based in Rome adds housing and travel allowances.

name: WIPO Internship Program
amount: CHF 1,645/month (Category I) or CHF 2,170/month (Category II)
tags: Final-year undergrads, Master's or recent grads

eligibility.note: Generally nationals of WIPO Member States — confirm in the posting

fields: Intellectual property law, economics, IT, communications, administration
note: Stipend depends on education level; any university/government funding is deducted from it. WIPO does not provide accommodation.

name: UNFPA Internship Programme
amount: Monthly stipend set by duty station (e.g. ~US$279/month in Türkiye) if not otherwise funded
dlText: Per posting / annual global internship roster
tags: Students after 1st year, postgrads or recent grads
fields: Population, gender, health, data, communications, operations
note: Interns get no salary but receive a stipend if not funded by a university, government or scholarship (UNFPA tops up partial funding). Apply via postings or the Global Internship Roster.

name: IOM Internships
amount: Monthly stipend set per posting/location (e.g. THB 12,018/month Bangkok); some posts unpaid
tags: Final-year undergrads, grad students or recent grads
Diversity & Inclusion programme covers travel + visa
fields: Migration, humanitarian response, data, HR, communications
note: Most IOM calls offer a modest monthly stipend, but some are non-remunerated and interns with outside funding are ineligible for it. Check each call; the Diversity and Inclusion Internship Programme targets persons with disabilities and under-represented nationalities.

name: UNIDO Internship Programme
amount: Monthly stipend based on duty station (since Sept 2025; amount: check posting)
tags: Final-year Bachelor's, Master's+ or graduated ≤12 months

eligibility.note: Students or recent graduates from UNIDO Member States

fields: Industrial development, energy, environment, trade, digitalisation
note: From September 2025 UNIDO pays interns a monthly stipend; travel, visa, accommodation and insurance remain the intern's cost.

name: OPCW Internship Programme
host: Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons
amount: €540/month
tags: Enrolled (1+ year done) or graduated ≤1 year

eligibility.note: Nationals of States Parties to the Chemical Weapons Convention

fields: Chemistry, verification, law, international relations, administration
note: Interns in The Hague normally receive €540 a month; it does not cover travel, visa or housing, and interns need their own insurance.

name: Council of Europe Traineeship Programme
amount: ≈€1,320/month (gross)
dlText: ~17 Jun 2027, 23:59:59 CEST, estimated from 2026 cycle (4–17 Jun 2026)
fields: Law, human rights, politics, communications, administration
note: Six-month paid traineeship in Strasbourg, one session a year starting October. You cannot apply if you have already had a CoE traineeship, study visit or job.

name: Paid Traineeships at the Court of Justice of the EU
host: Court of Justice of the European Union
amount: ≈€2,400/month + €150 travel contribution (if ≥200 km away)
dlText: 15 Sep 2026 for Mar–Jul 2027 session (time not stated)
tags: Law, political science or translation graduates

eligibility.note: Mainly EU nationals; confirm nationality rules on the official page

fields: Law, translation/interpreting, communications
note: Five-month paid traineeships in Luxembourg, twice a year (March and October starts). A separate inclusive programme exists for candidates with a disability.

name: European Court of Auditors Traineeships
amount: €2,000/month (AI traineeships €2,500)
fields: Audit, accounting, economics, law, AI/IT
note: Paid traineeships of 3–6 months in Luxembourg under ECA Decision 3-2026. Only one traineeship per person and no previous EU-institution employment.

name: NATO Internship Programme (NATO HQ)
amount: €1,335/month (2026 rate, adjusted yearly)
dlText: 30 Apr 2026 for Mar/Sep 2027 starts (time not stated)
fields: International relations, security, law, communications, IT, engineering
note: Six-month paid, full-time internship in Brussels; the call opens once a year in April–May. Other NATO bodies (SHAPE, NDC, NCIA, JFC Brunssum) run their own paid schemes.

name: IDB Group Internship Program
amount: Paid (amount: check posting)
dlText: Per posting; HQ calls twice a year
tags: HQ: citizens of the 48 IDB member countries
Country offices: citizens/residents of that country

eligibility.note: Washington HQ internships: citizens of IDB member countries (IDB Invest postings may have no restriction); country-office internships: citizens/legal residents of that country

fields: Economics, finance, development, data, infrastructure
note: Paid internships at IDB headquarters (summer and winter cycles) and in country offices across Latin America and the Caribbean.

name: BIS Graduate Programme
amount: Salary (net of Swiss tax) + health insurance, return travel and accommodation in Basel
dlText: Usually advertised in spring — check vacancies

eligibility.note: Nationality rules not stated in sources found — check vacancy

fields: Economics, finance, statistics, IT and related fields
note: Paid non-renewable contract of up to 11 months at BIS headquarters for recent graduates. BIS also runs a PhD Fellowship (2027 deadline 6 Nov 2026).

name: EFTA Traineeships
amount: ≈€1,510/month net (ESO figure; check official page)
tags: Nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland
fields: Trade law, EEA affairs, economics, statistics
